Welcome to your home away from home in the heart of Reykjavík! Imagine stepping into a cozy and luxurious retreat, designed just for you and your loved ones. Whether you're here to explore the vibrant city life or unwind under the magical Icelandic skies, our place is the perfect haven. Let’s get acquainted with your soon-to-be favorite spot!

The space
Come on in and make yourself at home! Our place is all about blending comfort with style, offering a delightful mix of modern finishes and Icelandic charm. 

✔ Spacious living and dining area with elegant interiors – a great spot to unwind after a day of adventures.
✔ Fully equipped kitchen – everything you need to whip up a homemade meal and then some!

★ ROOM DETAILS ★

♛ Bedroom 1: Queen Bed – Snuggle into our exclusive down duvets and premium pillows.
♛ Bedroom 2: King Bed – Drift off into a restful sleep with our comfy linens.
♛ Bedroom 3: Queen Bed – Wake up refreshed and ready for your next adventure.

★ BATHROOMS ★

Our two luxurious bathrooms are sleek and modern, designed with your comfort in mind. 

✔ Walk-in showers with complimentary essentials.
✔ Thoughtful touches like shampoo, conditioner, and body soap included.

★ OUTDOORS ★

✔ Private rooftop balcony with panoramic views – a rare find in Reykjavík!

Guest access
✔ Private secured underground garage parking for 1 car, plus free street parking – a real treat in central Reykjavík!
✔ Elevator access – no stairs to worry about.

Other things to note
We're all about making your stay as comfortable as possible:

✔ In-house laundry facilities – washer and dryer included.
✔ Family-friendly amenities like a crib, high chair, and children's dinnerware are available upon request.
✔ Fast WiFi for staying connected.
✔ Daily housekeeping available at an extra cost if you fancy a break from tidying up.

★ WHY YOU’LL LOVE IT ★

Our home is one of the few in Reykjavík offering a private outdoor Jacuzzi with breathtaking views. Many guests have been lucky enough to glimpse the northern lights from the balcony! Plus, you're just steps away from the city's best restaurants, cafés, and attractions like Laugavegur shopping street and Hallgrímskirkja.

So, pack your bags and get ready for an unforgettable Icelandic adventure. We can't wait to welcome you!
